import pandas as pd
pd.set_option('display.max_columns', None)
df=pd.read_csv('inventory.csv')
eips=df[df['resource_kind'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower().eq('elastic_ip')]
print(eips.to_string(index=False))
print('\nElastic IP states:',eips['state'].value_counts(dropna=False).to_dict())
print('\nUnassociated IDs:')
print(eips.loc[eips['state'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower().eq('unassociated'),'resource_id'].tolist())
